value: This article outlines significant new features in macOS, primarily highlighting the introduction of Apple Intelligence on Apple Silicon Macs, designed to personalize and accelerate user tasks. Key enhancements boost productivity and seamless workflow, including enhanced iPhone integration (such as mirroring), dynamic workspace tiling, and a new cross-device Passwords app. The update also features richer communication in Messages, new capabilities in Maps and Notes, expanded gaming support, and refined functionalities across apps like Calculator, Photos, Weather, and the Home app. Collectively, these advancements, alongside bolstered privacy controls, aim to deliver a more powerful and intuitive Mac experience.
